title: Proclamation S.I. 2001, No 21 of February 16, 2001 of the Integrated Circuits Act (Act 1998-21)
text:

YH
Proclamation S.I. 2001, No. 21 of February 16, 2001 of the
Integrated Circuits Act (Act 1998-21)
S.I. 2001 No. 21
By His Excellency Sir Clifford Straughn Husbands, Knight Grand Cross of the Most
Distinguished Order of Saint Michael and Saint George, Knight of St. Andrew,
Governor-General of Barbados.
C. Straughn Husbands
Governor-General
A Proclamation
Whereas by section 20 of the Integrated Circuits Act, (Act 1998-21) it is provided that
the said Act shall come into operation on a date to be fixed by proclamation:
And whereas it is expedient that the said Act shall come into operation on the 19th day
of February, 2001:
Now therefore by virtue of the power and authority in me vested, I hereby appoint the
19th day of February, 2001 as the day on which the said Act shall come into operation.
Given under my hand and the Public Seal of Barbados this sixteenth day of
February,2001 and in the fiftieth year of her Majesty’s Reign.
BB033EN Integrated Circuits (Act 1998-21), Proclamation (Commencement), page 1/1
16/02/2001, No. 21
